top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no annual training hours available for viewing.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were no written feeding instructions for the infant in care.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under two were watching television.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 out of 12 children did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by  caregivers.  The  required training topics are 3. administering medication 4.preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.
